campaign: Exact magic-number inventory, RepoDB closure authority, and systematic elimination
doctrine: Follow skill.md. This file is the single campaign authority; queue order is binding and plan complete means campaign complete. A magic is any hard-coded value, threshold, process horizon, distribution assumption, hidden model or tensor fact, device policy, or duplicated test expectation that could be derived, declared by an existing authority, or removed. RepoDB is the sole closure ledger; do not add MAGICS.json or another persistent registry. Extend internal/closurescan, internal/closureledger, existing RepoDB queries, and cmd/gate rather than creating parallel scanners or stores. Exact source binding means package, file, declaration or function identity, expression, evaluated value, owner artifact, and applicable callsites; name-only admission is forbidden. Scanner classification must use syntax and ownership, not numerical magnitude thresholds or assumptions about data shape or distribution. Model and tensor facts belong in artifact metadata, model profiles, recipes, or compiled plans. Protocol, ABI, mathematical, and fixture values may remain only under explicit typed dispositions. Tests should generate expected behavior from production contracts where practical; irreducible fixture data stays local and classified rather than being converted mechanically into constants. Cataloging is triage, not closure: each wave first deletes, derives, consolidates, or moves values to an existing authority, and records an open row only when a named evidence gap remains. No wrappers, compatibility readers, duplicate authorities, advisory-only production plans, or deferred caller migration. Every implementation wave migrates all callers and deletes displaced code in the same commit. Preserve numerical behavior, wire formats, recipe behavior, CUDA behavior, and Live Edit behavior where applicable. Measure named constants, inline literals, assumptions, open rows, deleted rows, code surface, allocations, transfers, and runtime when affected. Counts are command-derived and stored as RepoDB evidence; prose never owns mutable totals. New or changed uncatalogued production decision surfaces fail the gate once exact binding lands. The end state is zero uncatalogued decision surfaces, zero stale bindings, zero model/config facts duplicated in code, and zero derivation-blocked rows; remaining literals are mechanically structural or carry closed specification, mathematical, implementation, or fixture dispositions. After every gated implementation step, merge current master before starting the next step.

items.title: Bind closure evidence to exact source state in RepoDB

steps.title: Extend closure documents with understanding and exact typed source bindings
steps.rationale: The current document omits understanding and cannot prove that its name and value still describe the scanned source.

steps.title: Add one canonical active-binding query keyed by source identity rather than symbol name
steps.rationale: The gate currently treats any historical row sharing a symbol name as coverage.

steps.title: Republish existing closure evidence under the exact contract and delete the old reader path
steps.rationale: Keeping permissive legacy parsing would preserve name-only authority beside the exact contract.

items.title: Make exact magic drift a commit-gate refusal

steps.title: Validate declaration, value, owner artifact, callsites, tier, status, and disposition
steps.rationale: A catalog is useful only when code changes cannot silently invalidate its evidence.

steps.title: Replace advisory name matching with refusal for new, changed, stale, or unreadable bindings
steps.rationale: The current honesty line allows precisely the drift the campaign is intended to prevent.

steps.title: Reject increases in uncatalogued named, inline, test-policy, and assumption surfaces
steps.rationale: Exact rows cover named constants; delta ratchets prevent the backlog from moving into unnamed literals or tests.

items.title: Publish reproducible magic denominators and closure pressure

steps.title: Emit deterministic JSON and text census reports from the shared scanner
steps.rationale: Mutable counts belong to a command, not plan prose or manually maintained documentation.

steps.title: Store census fingerprint, counts, unresolved bindings, and closure pressure as RepoDB evidence
steps.rationale: Progress and regressions need queryable evidence tied to a source and catalog state.

steps.title: Expose open rows, stale rows, owner pressure, and before/after census through existing RepoDB queries
steps.rationale: Systematic elimination requires sortable owner and closure views without another dashboard store.

items.title: Eliminate optimizer, training, evaluation, and statistical decision magics

steps.title: Derive schedules and tolerances, consolidate shared policy, and record only evidenced residual obligations
steps.rationale: These packages contain decision thresholds, process horizons, and statistical assumptions that directly affect training and promotion.

items.title: Eliminate server, sampling, operation, dataset, and media policy magics

steps.title: Move declared controls to recipes or resource policy and derive limits from request and ownership plans
steps.rationale: Request limits, polling intervals, media bounds, and sampler defaults must have one typed owner instead of command and handler literals.

items.title: Eliminate CUDA, memory, launch, transfer, and workspace magics

steps.title: Derive extents from compiled plans or bind fixed values to kernel and device ABI contracts
steps.rationale: Launch geometry and byte widths must come from shared typed operations, measured device policy, or guarded ABI declarations.

items.title: Eliminate model, projector, inference, and modality facts duplicated in code

steps.title: Move model facts to artifacts and recipes and make compiled neutral plans their sole consumers
steps.rationale: Model dimensions, token IDs, topology choices, and modality geometry must not remain as family or checkpoint literals in generic runtime code.

items.title: Classify and consolidate format, quantization, codec, and artifact constants

steps.title: Bind specification values to typed protocol owners and eliminate duplicated encodings and layout arithmetic
steps.rationale: Specification constants may remain, but only in their protocol owner and never duplicated as runtime policy.

items.title: Close remaining production and command magic surfaces

steps.title: Audit every remaining internal and cmd owner and delete redundant flags, defaults, wrappers, and process constants
steps.rationale: Scoped waves must not leave uncatalogued debt in converters, tools, automation, or less frequently exercised packages.

items.title: Remove duplicated production policy from tests

steps.title: Use production contracts and shared assertions while retaining irreducible typed fixtures
steps.rationale: Tests should exercise production behavior rather than reimplement defaults, exit codes, dimensions, or tolerance policy in assertions.

items.title: Reach and enforce zero open magic debt

steps.title: Close every derivation-blocked row and verify no stale, uncatalogued, or duplicated authority remains
steps.rationale: The campaign ends only when unresolved constants have been derived, replaced, consolidated, or made irrelevant.

steps.title: Make the zero-debt checks permanent and delete campaign-only import and compatibility machinery
steps.rationale: The result must remain enforced without retaining one-time migration surface.
